blocked.resolution: Discovery reads this plugin's redirect tables through the wix-wp-plugin-v2 bridge automatically. If the bridge is missing or the read fails, Requires Import Operator: re-run discovery with wix-wp-plugin-v2 connected, or export the plugin's redirects as CSV and pass them to url-redirects.js sources --input.

pitfalls.summary: Redirect rules are captured at discovery into state/url-preservation/source-redirects.ndjson with per-provider coverage in source-redirect-coverage.json. Backend import never writes them to Wix: the redirect helpers (url-redirects.js plan/apply/verify) install and check them after the website exists, timed by cutover. The capability stays pending until that path is live-verified.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-28 (Redirection 5.9.0): the plugin advertises redirection/v1 routes (/redirect, /group, /export/*) but the route classifier skips them as operational helpers. Rules are read from the redirection_items and redirection_groups tables instead; a group's status disables every rule in it.
The plugin also keeps redirect logs, 404 logs and hit counters (redirection_logs, redirection_404, last_count). They are never rules and are never captured as rules.

quirks: A rule's group can be an Apache or Nginx module group: those are server-config exports, not rules WordPress serves, and are kept with a server_module condition.
